card.name: Words before antihypertensive or drug-effect terms
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the' after verbs such as antagonize, blunt or potentiate, and the start of 'antihypertensive' after 'other' or 'certain', in drug-interaction sentences.

modes.label: The after interaction verb
modes.description: The word 'the' right after a verb like antagonize, blunt or potentiate, before 'effects'.
modes.example: Ziprasidone may antagonize<< the>> effects of levodopa and dopamine agon

modes.label: Start of antihypertensive
modes.description: The opening piece of 'antihypertensive' after 'other', 'another' or 'certain'.
modes.example: quetiapine extended-release tablets may enhance the effects of certain<< ant>>ihypertensive agents.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word beginnings like anthrop, psych and hem, with no clear link to the text itself.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or word start just before a drug-effect phrase in interaction warnings, such as 'antagonize the effects of'.
